beats.text: At last, Bharata asked for one thing. 'Give me your sandals.'
Rama agreed. He stepped onto a pair of golden sandals and gave them to his brother.
Bharata carried them on his head all the way home, as if he were carrying Rama himself.
'If you do not return on the very day the fourteen years end,' he said, 'I will enter the fire.'
He placed them on the throne and ruled in Rama's name, as a servant. Every decision was first laid before the sandals.
He would not live in the palace. He lived in a simple hut at Nandigram, outside the city, wearing bark cloth and matted hair.
He lived like an ascetic for fourteen years, waiting for his brother.
And Rama, so that the people would stop coming, went deeper into the forest.
